source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Engine Electrical, p.6Y-2

procedures.title: Battery replacement: selecting a unit
steps: Read the Peak Watt Rating (PWR) embossed near the base of the battery case.
Choose a replacement battery whose power rating is at least equal to the original.
notes: The PWR (max current times max voltage) measures cold cranking ability and is not the same as the ampere-hour rating; two batteries with equal ampere-hour ratings can have very different watt ratings.

procedures.title: Dry charge battery: activate
steps: Break the hard rubber seal in each vent well by pressing the Delco Eye down into the well; the seals may stay in the cells, they are inert.
Fill every cell with electrolyte (dilute sulfuric acid, specific gravity 1.265 at 80°F).
Stop filling a cell when the electrolyte reaches the bottom of the split vent at the base of the vent well; the surface looks distorted when it touches the split vent (see figure 4b in the manual).
